About Us

Why Choose Royal Travels?

Based in Mahandi Kadal, Anantnag, Kashmir, Royal Travels Agency has been the trusted partner for thousands of pilgrims from Jammu & Kashmir. We are a government-approved, AJKHUTOA-member agency with KSA licensing.

🏛

Govt. Approved

Fully licensed by the Indian government & Saudi authorities.

AJKHUTOA Member

Experienced Team

Expert Mutawwifs & guides who personally accompany each group.
